(async () => { const out=[]; for (const u of ['/pose.jpg','/photo2.jpg','/photo1.jpg']) { await MM.app.testing.loadFromUrl('http://127.0.0.1:8137/.test'+u); const img=document.getElementById('photo'); const res=await MM.detector.detect(img, ()=>{}); const lm=res.landmarks; if(!lm){out.push({u, none:true});continue;} const W=img.naturalWidth,H=img.naturalHeight; const Y=i=>lm[i].y*H; const eyesY=(Y(2)+Y(5))/2, noseY=Y(0), mouthY=(Y(9)+Y(10))/2; const feat=[['eyes',0.47,eyesY],['nose',0.72,noseY],['mouth',0.84,mouthY]]; const n=3; const dBar=feat.reduce((s,f)=>s+f[1],0)/n, yBar=feat.reduce((s,f)=>s+f[2],0)/n; let num=0,den=0; for(const f of feat){num+=(f[1]-dBar)*(f[2]-yBar);den+=(f[1]-dBar)**2;} const b=num/den, a=yBar-b*dBar; const footY=Math.max(Y(27),Y(28),Y(29),Y(30),Y(31),Y(32)); out.push({u, W, H, head:b, crown:a, span:footY-a, heads:(footY-a)/b, res:feat.map(f=>[f[0], +(f[2]-a-b*f[1]).toFixed(1)]), earY:[+(Y(7)).toFixed(1),+(Y(8)).toFixed(1)], earDepth:[+((Y(7)-a)/b).toFixed(3),+((Y(8)-a)/b).toFixed(3)], vis:{eyes:+((lm[2].visibility+lm[5].visibility)/2).toFixed(2), nose:+lm[0].visibility.toFixed(2), mouth:+((lm[9].visibility+lm[10].visibility)/2).toFixed(2), ears:+((lm[7].visibility+lm[8].visibility)/2).toFixed(2)}});} return JSON.stringify(out,null,1); })()
